provenance.notes: Read on 2026-11-10. Limits: no request count is limited ('There are no limits on concurrent requests'); characters are, per hour and by tier - F0 (free) 2,000,000 an hour, to be used evenly (about 33,300 a minute), S1 and multi-service 40,000,000, S2/C2 40,000,000, S3/C3 120,000,000, S4/C4 200,000,000; a request holds at most 1,000 texts and 50,000 characters (detection: 100 texts); a synchronous document at most 10 MB, 6,000,000 characters a minute. Out of quota: 429; a spent free trial: 403. A call count cannot express characters: a site sets its own limits (policy). Data retention: text translation does not store customer data; document translation stores it while it works, then deletes it for good. Commercial use and attribution: the pages read do not state them, hence unknown and not required. The free tier's monthly amount was not read (only the hourly limits above).
